exposure: term prelabor rupture of membranes (term PROM)
positive vaginal swab for beta-hemolytic streptococcus
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 884 pregnant women with term prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM)
finding: A clinical protocol that induced labor only in women with high-risk factors for chorioamnionitis resulted in similar maternal and perinatal outcomes compared to expectant management in low-risk women, without increasing Cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: This study found that a clinical protocol managing term PROM with immediate induction only in women with high risk factors for infection achieved similar maternal and perinatal outcomes compared to expectant management in low-risk women, reducing the need for universal induction and associated complications.
